The HECC compressor has a splittered impeller with 15 main-blade/splitter-blade pairs.
The impeller has a spanwise varying backsweep between 32° to 42° from radial.
The compressor has a vaned diffuser with 20 main/splitter vane pairs.
The EGV blade row comprises 60 cascade style airfoils.
The design speed is 21,789 rpm, corrected to inlet conditions.
The impeller exit speed is 1615 ft/s.
The compressor was tested in the NASA Small Engine Components Test Facility (cell CE-18) at the Glenn Research Center.
The uncertainty of the orifice-based mass flow measurement system is ± 0.1 lb/s.
The uncertainty of the temperature measurements is ± 2.3 R for inlet conditions and ± 2.5 R for stage exit measurements.
The data system scans all measurement channels at a sampling rate of 1 Hz.
A minimum dwell time of 2 min was observed prior to data collection.
The compressor has a tip clearance of 0.012 in.
The compressor has a hub flow path alignment with a forward facing step for ɛ > ɛ and an aft facing step for ɛ < ɛ.
The backplate leakage flow was controlled through the use of buffer air injected into the center of a multi-row labyrinth seal.
